description:
Buys or confirms the monthly chat pass: $0.10 per 30 days, through x402 or credit.
A pass that is already valid returns 200 without charging again: you can call it before writing, with no risk of paying twice. The pass belongs to the person who speaks in the chat: the `X-Guest-Token` guest (the one the WebSocket recognizes in `hello`); without a guest, the account session, which speaks only over HTTP. It stays in the global purchase record (`direito`).
name: chat_pass
title: Chat pass
